newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil soyoil shipments up 74 pct Jan-Dec - SGS.
newsitem.headline: Brazil soyoil shipments up 74 pct Jan-Dec - SGS.

text.p: Shipments of soyoil from Brazilian ports rose 74 percent in January compared with the previous month for a 1.6 percent increase year-on-year, inspection company SGS do Brasil said.
Shippings of soymeal were 396,900 tonnes, up 1.6 percent on December 1996 but down 45.1 percent on the same period last year, SGS said in a statement.
Paranagua port registered the highest amount of soymeal shipments with 199,600 tonnes, followed by Rio Grande with 124,600 tonnes and Santos with 17,700 tonnes.
Another product which registered numbers favourable to Brazil's trade balance was corn meal, up 49.4 percent month-on-month.
Corn exports also rose, totalling 107,400 tonnes in January compared with none during the same month last year. All of it was shipped through Paranagua.
